description: Standalone error whose reply_to falls back to its own id (qluster resolution)
_comment: EDGE CASE, NOT the norm. A well-threaded error replies to its predecessor's id. This fixture exercises the last-resort own-id fallback used ONLY for an orphan result/error that has no predecessor: reply_to equals the envelope's OWN id so it stays schema-valid (result/error MUST have a non-null reply_to). The SDK now emits an onError/on_error warning whenever this fallback fires, so it is never silent. Named explicitly so nobody mistakes self-referential reply_to for correct threading.
